purpose: Assess a storage-bounded full-event F1 physical-derivative recipe after the failed dp015 numerical bridge.

bounded_proxy_reads.note: Only the existing F1 MeasureTool elevation/pressure CSVs and the mapped SPHERIC workbook were read for the sampling proxy; no native solver frame or full particle array was read.

bridge.other_height_probes: H2-H4 pass the numerical metrics, but native-integrity/lifecycle evidence remains pending.

budget.basis: STATUS.new_usage_completed_only.bytes and parent terminal NAS accounting; active external reservation was released after the small actual extraction.
budget.reservation_policy: Forecast only. A future request must use measured runtime estimates and the terminal guard; these figures are not a reservation.

sampling_proxy.method: Select nearest existing fine-run samples at the target interval, retain the final 6 s sample, and rerun the frozen comparison script. This is an observation-sampling proxy, not a solver run at the new TimeOut.
sampling_proxy.coverage: Both proxies retained all H1-H4/P1-P8 labels, finite values, and the 0..6.00005 s simulation bracket; each label had one sample outside the SPHERIC reference bracket, matching the existing comparison behavior.

basis.model: Scale the measured fine solver bytes by the estimated child particle count (fixed boundary plus fill-height-scaled fluid count) and by saved-frame count. This is a planning estimate, not an exact charge.

storage_forecast.interpretation: Both full-event fine pairs are storage-feasible in this rough model after reducing only saved-frame density, subject to measured GenCase/postprocess/receipt overhead and the runtime terminal guard. The original .01 pair forecast is about 36.43 GiB of solver output alone and cannot fit the 22.53 GiB remaining headroom.

recommendation.preferred_conditional_recipe: If and only if an accepted 3D mother gate is established without changing the frozen bridge threshold, use dp=0.01, full TimeMax=6 s, and TimeOut=0.025 s for H050/H060. Record TimeOut as a separate numerical/output-sampling recipe and retain all native spatial particles at every saved frame.
recommendation.contingency_recipe: TimeOut=0.03 s leaves more budget margin but has a slightly larger primary proxy delta; use it only if the measured request estimate requires the margin.
recommendation.current_decision: Do not launch DP015 H050/H060. Do not claim the fine mother is accepted from this proxy or from the diagnostic comparison. Without a valid mother acceptance path, retain the existing fine/bridge diagnostic products and report the M3 physical branch blocked.
recommendation.full_event_justification: The frozen F1 contract binds 0..6 s, all H1-H4 surface histories, and all P1-P8 pressure histories. H4 is the reservoir history and the pressure contract defines the impact window as the full official 0..6 s run; no narrower event interval is declared. Saved-frame reduction preserves the full event span, while truncation would remove required evidence.
required_before_any_launch: Freeze the chosen TimeOut in the request and definition receipt as a numerical/output-schedule difference.
Establish the applicable 3D mother acceptance evidence; M1 qualification does not transfer automatically to children.
Bind official fine dp=0.01 definitions with only fillbox z changed for H050/H060 and retain all fixed controls.
Use a measured storage estimate including GenCase, native solver output, postprocess, receipts, and any temporary peak; do not treat this forecast as a reservation.
Run the full 0..6 s event and recheck H/P coverage and native identity before any product credit.
